Landing pass status — verified on 9b589c108e3 (your head + my one test-alignment commit):

Green: 3,533 chat/new-session units, the isolated-lane lifecycle contract, corner-shape contract, capability-menu/model-catalog/history-issuance e2e, full-branch Sol autoreview (clean, 0.98). I pushed one commit aligning `chat-flow.active-run-follow-ups.e2e.test.ts` to your attached-queue design (waiting conveyed by row presence; behavioral invariants kept) — that was the checks-ui-e2e 5/12 failure.

One remaining deterministic failure, in your own suite (checks-ui-e2e 2/12, reproduces locally solo):

`ui/src/e2e/browser-dictation-status.e2e.test.ts`
1. "gates unavailable voice capabilities in the microphone picker": `getByRole("button", { name: "Talk settings" })` count is 0 — the picker's unavailable-gating state no longer renders the Talk settings entry your test expects (looks like fallout from moving voice availability alerts into the picker).
2. "keeps dictation activity and the insert/discard actions visible": `phase.textContent()` is now `"\n  Listening…\n"` — the shimmer wrapper added whitespace; the `.toBe("Listening…")` exact equality needs a trim (or assert on the trimmed value).

Since this is your active dictation surface I didn't guess the intended gating shape. Everything else is land-ready — push the fix (or say the word and I'll trim-and-restore per your test's current expectations) and I'll run the landing flow the moment exact-head CI is green.

One real blocker found on 0b001e72e94 before I land this (everything else is green — 183 CI checks, my full local battery, Sol autoreview clean):

`chat-flow.queue-edit.e2e.test.ts` — "edits a queued message in its row" and "keeps edit, remove, and reorder outcomes exact through reconnect" fail **deterministically on a loaded machine** (100% repro on an M-series Mac under load, 3/3 runs) while passing on fast CI runners. The failure shape is not flake — the **saved** row text ends up as the new text concatenated with the old:

```
- "then update the docs and the changelog"
+ "then update the docs and the changelogthen update the docs"
```

Since the corrupted value survives submit, `editingText` state itself got poisoned — the select-all → insertText sequence raced the edit row's focus/selection lifecycle (the `autofocus` + `@focus` end-caret `setSelectionRange` handler + the `.value=${props.editingText ?? item.text}` rebind in `chat-composer-queue.ts` interleave). Slow machines lose the race; real users editing a queued message can save concatenated garbage.

Suggested direction: make the seeded selection state deterministic — set the initial value+caret once when the editor mounts (ref callback) instead of via a `@focus` handler that can fire after the user (or harness) has already changed the selection, and drop `autofocus` in favor of an explicit focus in the same mount path. Happy to take it if you're wrapping up — otherwise this is the last item between the current head and merge; I'll land on your next green head.

Correction on my last finding, with apologies for the noise: instrumenting the test showed `Control+A` never selected at all on macOS — it's the native caret-to-line-start binding in Mac textareas, so `insertText` landed at position 0 and produced the concatenation. **Not a product race** — your edit path is sound (and your mount-once seeding in c087230 is good hygiene regardless). Linux CI passed legitimately.

Pushed cb12cde341d switching both chords to `ControlOrMeta+A` (portable select-all); the suite now passes 3/3 on the Mac rig that reproduced the failure. That was the last item — landing on green exact-head CI.

Merged via squash.

- Landed commit: [18beca535036813918e8826e27abf2a564ed1b0b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/18beca535036813918e8826e27abf2a564ed1b0b)
